name: RTC Vector Engine
description: Ported from RTCV's real RTC_VectorEngine.GenerateUnit: repeatedly picks a random address, aligns it to Precision + Alignment (safeAddress = address - address % precision + alignment), clamps it back in range if it overshoots, and writes a random (or list-picked) 32-bit constant there. The address math is copied directly from RTCV's source; the curated per-game Limiter/Value lists RTCV normally draws from are approximated here with a plain byte range and an optional user-supplied value list, since that curated database isn't something a standalone file tool has access to.
author: Ported from RTCV (RTC_VectorEngine.cs) for RTCFS4A

parameters.label: Blast Count
parameters.description: How many random 32-bit writes to perform. RTCV normally does one of these per engine tick for as long as corruption is live; this bakes that many ticks into one pass. Use the number box next to the slider for exact values.

parameters.label: Precision
parameters.description: Address alignment width, in bytes. RTCV defaults to 4 (32-bit) unless a game's memory domain reports a wider bus, which is what "Unlock Precision" exposed — set it directly here instead.

parameters.label: Alignment
parameters.description: Sub-offset added after rounding down to Precision, exactly as in the original: safeAddress = address - (address % precision) + alignment.

parameters.label: Start Byte
parameters.description: -1 = auto (right after Header Size below). Stands in for RTCV's per-game Limiter List, which restricts which addresses are eligible.

parameters.label: Header Size
parameters.description: Bytes to leave alone at the start of the file when Start Byte is -1. 16 for .nes/.fds, 512 for headered .smc, 0 for a headerless ROM.

parameters.label: Big Endian
parameters.description: Byte order for the 32-bit value written at each address — matches the target memory domain's endianness, same as RTCV's per-domain BigEndian flag.

parameters.label: Use Value List
parameters.description: RTCV normally draws each write's value from a curated, per-game Value List. Turn this on to supply your own; off picks a uniformly random 32-bit value each time instead.

parameters.label: Value List (hex, comma-separated)
parameters.description: e.g. DEADBEEF, 0x00000000, FFFFFFFF — each blast picks one of these at random instead of a fully random value.

parameters.label: Use Fixed Seed
parameters.description: Reuse the same seed to reproduce identical corruption on identical input.
